It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit

d = np.genfromtxt('spectrum.csv', delimiter=',', names=True)
x = d[d.dtype.names[0]]
y = d[d.dtype.names[1]]

def lor(x, x0, gamma, amp, off):
    return amp*gamma**2/((x-x0)**2+gamma**2)+off

def fit(lo, hi, guess):
    m = (x>=lo)&(x<=hi)
    xs, ys = x[m], y[m]
    p0 = [guess, 20.0, ys.max()-np.median(ys), np.median(ys)]
    p, cov = curve_fit(lor, xs, ys, p0=p0, maxfev=200000)
    res = ys - lor(xs, *p)
    rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(res**2))
    ss = np.sum((ys-np.mean(ys))**2)
    r2 = 1-np.sum(res**2)/ss
    return p, rms, r2, m.sum()

print('=== D ===')
for lo,hi in [(1200,1500),(1250,1450),(1230,1480),(1280,1420),(1200,1520),(1150,1550)]:
    p,rms,r2,n = fit(lo,hi,1350)
    print(f'win {lo}-{hi} n={n} x0={p[0]:.3f} gamma={p[1]:.3f} amp={p[2]:.2f} off={p[3]:.2f} rms={rms:.2f} r2={r2:.5f}')

print('=== G ===')
for lo,hi in [(1450,1700),(1480,1680),(1500,1660),(1460,1720),(1400,1750),(1520,1640)]:
    p,rms,r2,n = fit(lo,hi,1580)
    print(f'win {lo}-{hi} n={n} x0={p[0]:.3f} gamma={p[1]:.3f} amp={p[2]:.2f} off={p[3]:.2f} rms={rms:.2f} r2={r2:.5f}')

print('=== 2D ===')
for lo,hi in [(2400,3000),(2450,2950),(2500,2900),(2350,3000),(2550,2850),(2450,2900)]:
    p,rms,r2,n = fit(lo,hi,2690)
    print(f'win {lo}-{hi} n={n} x0={p[0]:.3f} gamma={p[1]:.3f} amp={p[2]:.2f} off={p[3]:.2f} rms={rms:.2f} r2={r2:.5f}')
EOF

names = data.dtype.names

y = data[names[1]]

def lorentzian(xv, x0, gamma, amplitude, offset):
    return amplitude * gamma**2 / ((xv - x0)**2 + gamma**2) + offset

def fit_peak(lo, hi, x0_guess, gamma_guess=20.0):
    mask = (x >= lo) & (x <= hi)
    xs, ys = x[mask], y[mask]
    offset0 = float(np.median(ys))
    amp0 = float(ys.max() - offset0)
    p0 = [x0_guess, gamma_guess, amp0, offset0]
    popt, pcov = curve_fit(lorentzian, xs, ys, p0=p0, maxfev=200000)
    resid = ys - lorentzian(xs, *popt)
    rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(resid**2)))
    ss_res = float(np.sum(resid**2))
    ss_tot = float(np.sum((ys - ys.mean())**2))
    r2 = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
    perr = np.sqrt(np.diag(pcov))
    return popt, rms, r2, perr

peaks = {
    'D':  (1250.0, 1450.0, 1350.0, 18.0),
    'G':  (1500.0, 1660.0, 1580.0, 10.0),
    '2D': (2500.0, 2900.0, 2690.0, 25.0),
}

results = {}
fits = {}
for name, (lo, hi, g, gg) in peaks.items():
    popt, rms, r2, perr = fit_peak(lo, hi, g, gg)
    fits[name] = popt
    results[name] = {
        'x0': float(popt[0]),
        'gamma': float(popt[1]),
        'amplitude': float(popt[2]),
        'offset': float(popt[3]),
    }
    print(f'{name:>3}: window {lo}-{hi}  x0={popt[0]:.4f}+/-{perr[0]:.4f}  gamma={popt[1]:.4f}+/-{perr[1]:.4f}  '
          f'amp={popt[2]:.3f}+/-{perr[2]:.3f}  off={popt[3]:.3f}+/-{perr[3]:.3f}  rms={rms:.2f}  R2={r2:.6f}')

results['ID_IG'] = float(fits['D'][2] / fits['G'][2])
print('I_D/I_G =', results['ID_IG'])

with open('/app/results.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
print('written /app/results.json')
EOF
python3 fit_spectrum.py
